title: listTasks() drops the most recent task
summary: lib/store.ts listTasks() returns a copy of the task list without its last element, so the GET that runs right after creating a task never includes it. On a one-item list the response is empty and the "creating a task..." test fails at toContainText on the task list.

expectedFailure.testTitle: creating a task shows it in the list and updates the counter
